description: 49 locally trained full-budget official-family policy checkpoints; no parameter arrays embedded.

selection_protocol.original: Select within each algorithm/task across seeds42/43/44 and the official 1x/2x budgets.
selection_protocol.frontier: Select within each algorithm/period across seeds42/43/44. PPO3.5 also includes the one independent 40M comparison chosen from training-tail evidence.
selection_protocol.fastest_demo: Among frontier validation-selected policies with all64 worlds complete and RMSE<5cm, choose shortest trained period, then minimum validation RMSE.
selection_protocol.ppo_robustness_label: PPO3.5 weights were selected by validation within PPO3.5. Better held-out robustness is a reported finding, not a test-driven replacement of the selection rule.

scope.figure8: cf21B_500, nominal first_principles, attitude policy; lower-level motor dynamics remain in the simulation.
scope.td3: cf2x_L250, first_principles, direct four-motor rotor_vel policy, trained for the fixed position[0,0,1.5].
scope.comparison: Different drones and tasks prevent a fair attitude-versus-rotor-control ablation.
scope.underactuation: Standard six-DOF/four-input quadrotors; no fixed-wing or missing-rotor validation.
scope.limits: Simulation under recorded tasks and finite budgets; not a proof of a global optimum, hardware speed limit or real-flight performance.
scope.retention: Unselected, degraded and precision-failing complete-budget runs remain included.
scope.gym_and_racing: Outside this manifest; see their evolving reports separately.

checkpoints.format: Python pickle containing NumPy parameter trees; actor, optional PPO critic and samples_dt.

selection.criterion: Maximize validation full-horizon completion; then minimize global first-episode tracking RMSE.
